info.title: Cargos API
info.description: Inventory and procurement platform. Register and log in, then paste access_token into Authorize. Data is isolated by account. Quantities are integers. Prices use minor currency units. All lists use limit/offset. DELETE archives products/suppliers. Demand records statistics; inventory consumption is a separate negative movement. Notifications are delivered asynchronously to the in-app inbox.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and revoke previous token pair

put.description: Full metadata replacement. Product SKU is immutable. Stock changes require a movement.

post.description: Statistical record only; does not decrement inventory. occurred_at defaults to current time. Record consumption with a negative stock movement.

Uses average demand over window_days. Reorder point=max(min_stock,ceil(daily_demand*lead_days)); target=max(target_stock,ceil(daily_demand*(lead_days+7))). Ordered incoming stock is deducted. Uses the selected active supplier or the fastest active supplier; default lead is 7 days. Saves a durable event; notification delivery retries every 2 seconds.

patch.summary: Mark notification as read or unread

post.description: The reference is unique per account. Repeating the same product, quantity, reason and reference returns the original movement. Reusing a reference with different data returns 409. Negative balances are rejected. Stock and ledger commit in one transaction.

draft → ordered/cancelled; ordered → receiving → received, or ordered → cancelled. Repeating the current state succeeds. Receiving adds inventory with reference purchase:{order_id}; retries cannot add stock twice. The receiving state is persisted before crediting stock; a background worker retries every 2 seconds after transient errors. Cancellation is blocked during receiving. You can also repeat the received request. expected_at is an estimate set at order creation.
